items.title: Uncertainty Quantification in Neural Networks for Latent-Driven Non-Gaussian Outputs
items.abstract: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for reliable predictions in artificial neural networks when latent sources of randomness produce non-Gaussian outputs for a given deterministic input. We propose UQ-ANN, a data-driven framework composed of two coupled subnetworks. The first subnetwork contains two feedforward neural networks: ANN1 predicts the conditional mean and ANN2 the conditional covariance of a reduced representation obtained by principal component analysis (PCA) of the outputs. The second subnetwork is an analytical stochastic generator and requires no training. It is based on a sparse Gaussian kernel density estimator (GKDE) constructed by adaptive clustering. The sparsification replaces the kernels associated with the training points by a reduced set of cluster-based kernels, while third- and fourth-moment descriptors are included in the merging criterion to preserve non-Gaussian features. Independent realizations in the reduced space are then generated, transformed to reproduce the conditional mean and covariance predicted by the first subnetwork, and mapped back to the original output space. They provide conditional statistics, conditional probability density functions, and conditional prediction intervals. A marginal log-density diagnostic is also used to assess the stochastic approximation. Numerical tests on synthetic datasets evaluate the sparse GKDE, the stochastic generator, and the complete UQ-ANN framework, including out-of-sample predictions.
items.authors: Christophe Desceliers, Christian Soize
items.title_zh: 神经网络中非高斯输出的不确定性量化
items.summary_zh: 不确定性量化（UQ）对于在潜在随机源产生非高斯输出时，人工神经网络的可靠预测至关重要。我们提出了UQ-ANN，一个由两个耦合子网络组成的数据驱动框架。第一个子网络包含两个前馈神经网络：ANN1预测通过主成分分析（PCA）获得的输出的条件均值，ANN2预测条件协方差。第二个子网络是一个分析性随机生成器，无需训练，基于通过自适应聚类构建的稀疏高斯核密度估计器（GKDE）。稀疏化过程用基于聚类的核替代与训练点相关的核，同时在合并标准中包含三阶和四阶矩描述符，以保留非高斯特征。然后在降维空间中生成独立实现，经过变换以重现第一个子网络预测的条件均值和协方差，并映射回原始输出空间。这些实现提供条件统计量、条件概率密度函数和条件预测区间。同时使用边际对数密度诊断来评估随机近似。对合成数据集的数值测试评估了稀疏GKDE。

items.title: Regional Digitalization and Food-Service Industry Productivity: Evidence from Russian Regions
items.abstract: This study examines how different dimensions of the regional digital environment are associated with productivity in the food-service sector across Russian regions. Using regional panel data, the study distinguishes among digital infrastructure, digital platform adoption, online consumption, and advanced digital technologies to examine whether these associations vary across regions with different levels of sectoral productivity. Digital infrastructure is consistently associated with higher food-service productivity, with stronger associations observed in lower-productivity regions, suggesting that digital connectivity may be particularly relevant to regional disparities in service-sector development. Digital platform adoption also demonstrates generally positive associations with productivity across the productivity distribution, highlighting the growing importance of digitally enabled service delivery and platform-based business models in food services. In contrast, online consumption has limited contemporaneous associations with productivity but shows a stronger positive association in higher-productivity regions, suggesting that the relationship between digital consumer demand and productivity may depend on existing regional capabilities. Advanced digitalization, captured through a PCA-based index of AI, IoT, big data, and cloud technologies, is negatively associated with productivity, potentially reflecting adjustment costs and the complementary organizational and managerial capabilities required for effective adoption.
items.authors: Han-Sol Lee, Xinyu Li, Anastasia V. Lukina, Vladislava I. Noga, Victoria A. Bondarenko, Sergey U. Chernikov

items.title: Variability and Trends in Ozone and Ozone-Related Stratospheric Trace Gases over St. Petersburg (Russia)
items.abstract: Anomalous ozone loss in the Northern Hemisphere during winter–spring periods has been increasingly observed in recent decades. Regular monitoring of stratospheric gases involved in ozone-depleting processes is essential for predicting the appearance of ozone mini-holes and the growth in UV surface irradiance. The St. Petersburg State University site located on the border of mid- and high latitudes is equipped with the Bruker IFS 125HR spectrometer for trace gas measurements and the UV and VIS Ocean Optics HR4000 spectrometers for total ozone column (TOC) measurements. The harmonization of TOC series from three instruments made it possible to analyze TOC variability during rapid changes in air masses. A decrease in ozone in the 8–18 km (−0.41 ± 0.33% yr−1) and 18–25 km (−0.17 ± 0.15% yr−1) layers, as well as in stratospheric HNO3 (−0.31 ± 0.18% yr−1), is observed for the 2009–2026 period, along with an increase in HF (+0.41 ± 0.20% yr−1) mainly due to changes in atmospheric dynamics over the past decade. An observed decrease in CCl3F (−0.43 ± 0.06% yr−1), CCl2F2 (−0.71 ± 0.04% yr−1), ClONO2 (−1.14 ± 0.82% yr−1), and HCl (−0.31 ± 0.16% yr−1) indicates a decrease in the chlorine-containing gases in the atmosphere. A comparison of the EMAC and SOCOLv3 simulations with observations for the common 2009–2019 period showed that ozone variability, including trends, seasonal variations, and rapid winter–spring changes, is described by the models within the measurement uncertainty limits, whereas for HCl, ClONO2, and HNO3, the quantitative discrepancy between the simulations and measurements exceeds the corresponding measurement uncertainty.
items.authors: Yana Virolainen, Alexander Polyakov, Svetlana Akishina, Dmitry Ionov, Peter Nerobelov, Eugene Rozanov

items.title: Development of the First Cytochrome Oxidase I Barcode and Evidence for a Dominant Variant Associated with the Recent United States Invasion of the Pasture Mealybug Heliococcus summervillei (Hemiptera: Pseudococcidae) Complex
items.abstract: The Heliococcus summervillei complex is an emerging invasive mealybug that causes severe dieback in grasses in pastures and turfgrass landscapes. It is widespread in Australia and has recently been detected across the Caribbean, Mexico, and the United States. Accurate mealybug identification is challenging because of cryptic and overlapping diagnostic characters and limited taxonomic expertise and literature, making molecular tools essential for regulatory diagnostics and management. We developed the first Cytochrome Oxidase I (COI) sequences for morphology-based Type A and Type B variants of the H. summervillei complex using the Jerry–Pat mid-COI fragment and used them to examine mitochondrial variation across available populations. COI sequences reveal approximately 10% mitochondrial split between the Type A and Type B variants. Phylogenetic, haplotype network, and genetic distance analyses show that all Type B populations share a single mitochondrial haplotype, consistent with a single dominant maternal lineage associated with a recent pasture mealybug invasion of the United States and Australia. Type A in Barbados contains two closely related haplotypes that may represent a historically stable mitochondrial variant corresponding to the holotype’s morphological description of H. summervillei, based on morphology. Together, these results establish the first COI reference library for the H. summervillei complex, resolve mitochondrial lineage structure, and provide a practical tool for rapid identification and timely regulatory and pest management responses.
items.authors: Muhammad Z. Ahmed, Peilin Tan, Nisha Yadav, Caroline Hauxwell, David L. Kerns, Blake Wilson

items.title: Detection of Neutrophil Extracellular Traps by Flow Cytometry in Healthy Controls and Patients with Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
items.abstract: Excessive induction of neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) formation (NETosis) and clearance system dysfunction lead to autoantigen accumulation, initiating autoimmune cascades in immune-mediated inflammatory rheumatic diseases. This study aims to quantitatively determine NETs using multicolor flow cytometry to evaluate the pathogenic role of NETosis in systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). The study enrolled 70 patients with a verified diagnosis of SLE (median age 38.0 [27.5; 46.0] years; 62 females, 8 males). The control group consisted of 20 sex- and age-matched healthy individuals. Laboratory evaluation included multicolor flow cytometry, enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), and indirect immunofluorescence assay. NETosis induction was performed using phorbol 12-myristate 13-acetate (PMA). The proportion of neutrophils undergoing NETosis following PMA stimulation was significantly higher in SLE patients than in healthy controls (69.3% versus 27.5%, respectively, p = 0.0006). Conversely, serum levels of citrullinated histone H3 (measured by ELISA) were significantly higher in healthy controls compared to SLE patients (p = 0.005). The systemic immune-inflammation index (SII) was substantially higher in the SLE group compared to the healthy control group (613.9 versus 27.5, p less than 0.05). Furthermore, the percentages of both spontaneous and PMA-induced NETs demonstrated significant differences in patients with severe disease courses. The developed methodological approach based on multiparametric flow cytometry serves as an objective monitoring tool and could be recommended for verifying inflammatory activity in patients with a long-standing history of SLE exceeding 2 years.
items.authors: Andrey P. Aleksankin, Anastasia S. Avdeeva, Yulia N. Gorbunova, Zhanna G. Verizhnikova, Liubov V. Kondratyeva, Alisa A. Tarasenko
items.title_zh: 流式细胞术检测健康人和系统性红斑狼疮患者的中性粒细胞外陷阱
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在通过多色流式细胞术定量检测中性粒细胞外陷阱（NETs），评估NETosis在系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）中的致病作用。研究纳入70名确诊为SLE的患者（中位年龄38.0岁；62名女性，8名男性），对照组为20名性别和年龄匹配的健康个体。实验方法包括多色流式细胞术、酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）和间接免疫荧光检测。使用12-肉豆蔻酸酯-13-醋酸酯（PMA）诱导NETosis。结果显示，SLE患者中经历NETosis的中性粒细胞比例显著高于健康对照组（69.3%对27.5%，p = 0.0006）。相反，健康对照组的柠檬酸化组蛋白H3水平显著高于SLE患者（p = 0.005）。SLE组的全身免疫炎症指数（SII）显著高于健康对照组（613.9对27.5，p < 0.05）。

items.title: Long-Term Oceanographic Survey for Social Implementation of OTEC Plant in Okinotorishima (Seawater Temperature, Salinity, Dissolved Oxygen, Inorganic Nutrients and Density)
items.abstract: In order to implement ocean thermal energy conversion (OTEC), it is necessary to maintain a stable temperature difference between surface seawater and deep seawater. Accordingly, numerous oceanographic surveys have been conducted to select sea areas suitable for OTEC deployment, not only around Japan but also in other countries around the world. However, long-term oceanographic survey data for the Okinotorishima area, a promising candidate for OTEC, are not yet available. While many studies have addressed OTEC design under generic conditions, designs based on specific areas have remained limited. However, the availability of oceanographic data necessary for conducting such studies is still limited. Therefore, a long-term oceanographic survey was conducted, starting in 2006. This study presents a systematic compilation of oceanographic survey results to lay the groundwork for evaluations for the installation of an OTEC plant. The survey items included the vertical profiles of seawater temperature, salinity, dissolved oxygen, and nutrients at each observation station. The results indicate that the temperature difference between surface seawater and deep seawater, which is the most important factor for OTEC, almost exceeded the threshold of 20 °C required for the realization of an OTEC plant. This study provides a foundational dataset for evaluating the feasibility of OTEC deployment, performing economic assessments, and organizing comprehensive long-term oceanographic data in Okinotorishima from an engineering perspective.
items.authors: Masaki Ariyoshi, Hideyuki Yoshimura, Junichi Ohara, Masateru Ishida, Junji Koga, Tatsuhiko Tanaka
items.category_raw: Journal of Marine Science and Engineering

items.title: Surface-Engineered 3D-Printed Polymeric Flat-Panel Photoreactors with P25 TiO2 Nanoparticles for Photocatalytic Hydrogen Evolution
items.abstract: In this work, a flat-panel photoreactor containing a serpentine channel was fabricated by LCD-based masked stereolithography and functionalized with commercial P25 TiO2. Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) confirmed laminar flow over 2–10 mL min−1 and described the velocity and wall-shear-stress distributions within the channel. Operating conditions were first established using suspended P25. Immobilization was then studied by varying binder type and content, P25 concentration and deposition method, together with pre-cure integration and direct printing of P25-loaded resin. The airbrushed P25/PARALOID™ B-72 coating provided the most favorable balance between reactor-level productivity and sustained response, with a post-maximum productivity retention of 47.8%. Direct printing reached the highest maximum apparent volumetric productivity (821.5 µmol H2,eq Lreactor−1 h−1), corresponding to 1.7 and 2.1 times the values obtained with suspended and airbrushed configurations, respectively, but showed a much lower productivity retention of 12.9%. Post-mortem X-ray diffraction (XRD) and scanning electron microscopy–energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (SEM–EDS) showed differences in P25 distribution and surface exposure among the tested configurations. These results show that the P25 incorporation strategy strongly affects both reactor-level productivity and operational stability.
items.authors: María José Torres, Jesús Román, María del Prado Garrido, Mireya Carvela

items.title: SGLT-2 Inhibitors Versus GLP-1 Receptor Agonists in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: A Propensity Score-Matched Cohort Study Comparing Adherence and Persistence with Specific Reference to Cardiovascular Disease
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Poor adherence and persistence to sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT-2is) and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) are a critical issue in the treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), especially in patients with cardiovascular disease (CVD). We aimed to compare adherence and persistence to these drugs in routine care. Methods: A retrospective propensity score-matched (PSM) cohort study was conducted using pharmacy claims data. Patients aged 40 years or older with T2DM initiating SGLT-2is or GLP-1 RAs from 1 January 2019 to 31 December 2024 were included. Adherence was measured using the Medication Possession Ratio (MPR), and persistence was defined as the time to discontinuation (gap ≥ 60 days between refills). Results: At the 1-year follow-up, the SGLT-2i cohort showed significantly higher adherence compared to the GLP-1 RA cohort (86.66% vs. 76.53%; OR = 2.02) and higher persistence (71.48% vs. 66.52% at 12 months; HR = 0.83). The main factors associated with lack of persistency were newly diagnosed T2DM (HR = 1.25) and insulin use (HR = 1.32). In the CVD subgroup, the differences in favor of the SGLT-2i cohort were more pronounced for adherence (89.57% vs. 78.12%; OR = 2.44) and persistence (73.9% vs. 63.59%; HR = 0.66). Conclusions: In real-world clinical practice, adherence and persistence rates were higher in patients on SGLT-2is compared to those on GLP-1 RAs, particularly in the CVD subgroup. Our findings suggest that the new strategies are necessary to improve adherence and persistence to these medications, particularly in patients with CVD.
items.authors: M. Asunción González-González, M. Aránzazu Pedrosa-Naudín, Diego Fernández-Lázaro, Isabel Díaz Planelles, F. Javier Álvarez, Eduardo Gutiérrez-Abejón
items.title_zh: SGLT-2抑制剂与GLP-1受体激动剂在2型糖尿病患者中的比较研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：在2型糖尿病（T2DM）治疗中，钠-葡萄糖共转运蛋白-2抑制剂（SGLT-2is）和胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂（GLP-1 RAs）的依从性和持续性差是一个关键问题，尤其是在心血管疾病（CVD）患者中。我们旨在比较这两种药物在常规护理中的依从性和持续性。方法：采用回顾性倾向评分匹配（PSM）队列研究，分析2019年1月1日至2024年12月31日期间，年龄在40岁及以上的T2DM患者使用SGLT-2is或GLP-1 RAs的药房索赔数据。依从性通过药物拥有比率（MPR）测量，持续性定义为停药时间（补药间隔≥60天）。结果：在1年随访中，SGLT-2i组的依从性显著高于GLP-1 RA组（86.66%对76.53%；OR = 2.02），持续性也更高（71.48%对66.52%；HR = 0.83）。缺乏持续性的主要因素为新诊断的T2DM（HR = 1.25）和胰岛素使用（HR = 1.32）。在CVD亚组中，SGLT-2i组的依从性（89.57%对78.12%；OR = 2.44）和持续性（73.9%对63.59%；HR = 0.66）差异更为明显。结论：在真实世界临床实践中，SGLT-2抑制剂在患者中的依从性和持续性更高。

items.title: Targeting EGR1 Attenuates CCL2 Expression in Inflammatory Keratinocytes and Allergic Skin Inflammation
items.abstract: Early growth response 1 (EGR1) is a zinc-finger transcription factor involved in inflammatory gene regulation, but the extent to which pharmacological inhibition of EGR1 DNA-binding activity influences inflammatory transcriptional responses in keratinocytes remains incompletely understood. Here, we explored the transcriptional effects of pharmacological EGR1 inhibition in tumor necrosis factor-α (TNFα)-stimulated HaCaT keratinocytes. RNA sequencing was employed as an exploratory, hypothesis-generating screen using three structurally related EGR1 inhibitors (IT21, IT23, and IT25) to identify candidate genes showing concordant expression patterns across the three pharmacological perturbations. This exploratory analysis suggested broader changes in inflammation-associated transcriptional programs and identified several leukocyte-recruiting chemokines among the candidate genes. CCL2 was selected as a representative candidate for independent biological and mechanistic validation. IT25 treatment and EGR1 knockdown attenuated TNFα-induced CCL2 expression, while promoter–reporter analysis, EGR1-binding site mutagenesis, EGR1 overexpression, and chromatin immunoprecipitation supported EGR1-dependent transcriptional regulation of CCL2 in keratinocytes. Furthermore, topical IT25 treatment attenuated house dust mite-induced atopic dermatitis-like skin inflammation and was associated with reduced epidermal CCL2 expression and inflammatory cell infiltration in vivo. Collectively, these findings establish EGR1-dependent regulation of CCL2 in inflammatory keratinocytes and support further investigation of EGR1 DNA-binding activity as a pharmacological target in cutaneous inflammation.
items.authors: Yena Choi, Euitaek Jung, Junekyu Han, Soon Young Shin
items.title_zh: 靶向EGR1减弱炎症角质形成细胞中的CCL2表达
items.summary_zh: 早期生长反应1（EGR1）是一种参与炎症基因调控的锌指转录因子，但其药物抑制EGR1 DNA结合活性对角质形成细胞炎症转录反应的影响尚不完全清楚。本研究探讨了药物抑制EGR1在肿瘤坏死因子α（TNFα）刺激的HaCaT角质形成细胞中的转录效应。采用RNA测序作为探索性筛选，使用三种结构相关的EGR1抑制剂（IT21、IT23和IT25）识别在三种药物干扰下表现出一致表达模式的候选基因。分析结果显示炎症相关转录程序的广泛变化，并识别出几种招募白细胞的趋化因子。CCL2被选为独立生物学和机制验证的代表性候选。IT25处理和EGR1敲低减弱了TNFα诱导的CCL2表达，进一步的实验支持了EGR1在角质形成细胞中对CCL2的转录调控作用。此外，局部IT25处理减轻了尘螨诱导的特应性皮炎样皮肤炎症。

items.title: Are Korean AI Firms Really Growing Sustainably? Operational Efficiency by Period, Firm Age, Firm Size, and Region
items.abstract: The sustainable growth of the AI industry depends not only on market expansion and technological advancement but also on whether AI supplier firms can efficiently transform their resource investments into stable economic outcomes. This study examines the operational efficiency of Korean AI supplier firms from the perspective of resource-efficient and sustainable growth and investigates differences across periods, firm age, firm size, and region. Using financial data from 95 firms over 2017–2025, we constructed 855 firm-year decision-making units and applied input-oriented data envelopment analysis under CRS and VRS. Nonparametric tests were subsequently used to compare efficiency across firm groups. The results show that both CRS and VRS efficiency declined over time, with the lowest efficiency observed during 2023–2025 despite the rapid diffusion of generative AI. Firms aged 19–25 years exhibited relatively higher efficiency than younger and older firms. Firm-size comparisons revealed contrasting patterns: SMEs showed higher CRS efficiency, whereas mid-sized enterprises exhibited higher VRS efficiency. Regional differences were significant for CRS efficiency but not for VRS efficiency, with firms outside Seoul and Gyeonggi showing relatively higher CRS efficiency. From a sustainability perspective, these findings indicate that rapid industry expansion based on increasing investments does not automatically lead to efficient or sustainable firm-level growth. The study therefore highlights the importance of resource-efficient operations, appropriate scale, and sustainable revenue structures in promoting the long-term economic sustainability of AI supplier firms and the AI industry.
items.authors: Young-Keun Jeong, Sangpil Yoon
items.title_zh: 韩国人工智能企业的可持续增长分析
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了韩国人工智能供应商企业的运营效率，关注资源高效和可持续增长的视角，分析了不同时间段、企业年龄、企业规模和地区的差异。研究使用2017年至2025年间95家企业的财务数据，构建了855个企业年度决策单元，并在常数规模报酬（CRS）和可变规模报酬（VRS）下应用了以投入为导向的数据包络分析。结果显示，CRS和VRS效率随时间下降，2023-2025年期间效率最低，尽管生成性人工智能迅速普及。19-25岁企业的效率相对较高，中小企业在CRS效率上表现优于大型企业，而中型企业在VRS效率上表现更佳。区域差异在CRS效率上显著，但在VRS效率上不明显，首尔和京畿以外的企业CRS效率相对较高。这些发现表明，基于投资增加的快速行业扩张对可持续性构成挑战。

items.title: Nanotechnology-Enabled Strategies for Enhancing Plant Abiotic Stress Tolerance
items.abstract: Amid increasingly complex climate scenarios, abiotic stresses such as drought, extreme temperatures, and soil salinization have emerged as primary bottlenecks limiting the sustainable development of modern agriculture. Because of their unique nanoscale effects and physicochemical properties, nanoparticles (NPs) can penetrate plant tissue barriers, offering a novel approach to enhance crop resilience to environmental stresses. This review systematically summarizes the core mechanisms by which NPs enhance plant stress tolerance. NPs primarily mitigate the overaccumulation of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and cellular oxidative stress by modulating antioxidant systems, thereby maintaining the physical integrity of photosynthetic apparatuses and cell membranes. Additionally, NPs regulate phytohormone signaling networks and the transcription of stress-responsive genes, while supporting ion compartmentalization and osmotic homeostasis in complex habitats such as coastal saline environments. Integrating multi-omics analyses, this review discusses plant metabolic responses to NPs and their dose-dependent toxicological effects. Addressing bottlenecks in practical application, we evaluate barriers to field-scale translation, the environmental release and migration of nanomaterials across water, air, and the food supply, and associated detection methods and safety risks, including the specific case of widely used silver nanoparticles. Future research must rely on multidisciplinary integration to optimize targeted delivery networks, premised on well-defined risk-assessment standards and viable cost–benefit balances, ultimately providing a scientific basis for enhancing agricultural climate resilience.
items.authors: Yusheng Li, Saddam Hussain, Lichen Wang, Siyu Chen, Wei Wang, Xiaoxiao Jing

items.title: Therapeutic Redox Reprogramming in Breast Cancer: From Antioxidant Modulation to Precision Nanomedicine
items.abstract: Breast cancer progression and therapeutic resistance are closely associated with disrupted redox homeostasis, in which oxidative stress drives tumor growth, metabolic adaptation, and treatment failure. Although antioxidants have traditionally been considered cytoprotective agents, their effects on tumor redox signaling are highly context-dependent, creating an antioxidant paradox that limits their therapeutic application. This review examines how dysregulated redox signaling shapes breast cancer biology and therapeutic response across ER+, HER2+, and triple-negative subtypes, with emphasis on the NRF2–KEAP1, p53, PI3K/AKT, MAPK, and HIF-1α pathways. These mechanisms provide a biological rationale for selectively modulating tumor redox states rather than broadly suppressing oxidative stress. Within this framework, redox-responsive nanocarriers and nanozymes offer opportunities for precise spatial and temporal redox modulation, enhanced tumor targeting, and controlled therapeutic activity while potentially minimizing effects on healthy tissues. Redox-directed nanotherapeutics may also influence the tumor immune microenvironment, angiogenesis, and metabolic rewiring. However, clinical translation remains constrained by dose- and context-dependent effects, intratumoral heterogeneity, limited biomarker validation, and inadequate predictive models. Personalized redox nanomedicine integrating subtype-specific redox profiling, smart nanotherapeutic platforms, and biomarker-guided patient stratification could establish redox modulation as a precision therapeutic axis and improve treatment outcomes in breast cancer.
items.authors: Nina Kummer, Sabina Gayibova, Takhir Aripov, Désirée Gül, Mustafa Dolaz, Burcu Önal Acet
items.title_zh: 乳腺癌中的治疗性氧化还原重编程：从抗氧化剂调节到精准纳米医学
items.summary_zh: 乳腺癌的进展和治疗抵抗与氧化还原稳态失调密切相关，氧化应激促进肿瘤生长、代谢适应和治疗失败。尽管抗氧化剂传统上被视为细胞保护剂，但其对肿瘤氧化还原信号的影响高度依赖于具体环境，形成了限制其治疗应用的抗氧化剂悖论。本文回顾了失调的氧化还原信号如何影响乳腺癌生物学及其在ER+、HER2+和三阴性亚型中的治疗反应，重点讨论了NRF2–KEAP1、p53、PI3K/AKT、MAPK和HIF-1α通路。这些机制为选择性调节肿瘤氧化还原状态提供了生物学依据。氧化还原响应的纳米载体和纳米酶为精确的空间和时间氧化还原调节、增强肿瘤靶向性和控制治疗活性提供了机会，同时可能最小化对健康组织的影响。然而，临床转化仍受剂量和环境依赖性效应、肿瘤内异质性、有限的生物标志物验证和不足的预测模型的限制。个性化氧化还原纳米医学的前景仍需进一步探索。

items.title: Integrated Proteome and Phosphoproteome Profiling Reveals Abundance-Independent Phosphorylation Remodeling in Hepatocellular Carcinoma
items.abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is characterized by extensive molecular heterogeneity, yet changes in protein abundance alone may not fully capture the regulatory alterations that drive tumor biology. Here, we performed integrated whole-proteome and phosphoproteome profiling of paired HCC and adjacent non-tumorous liver tissues to distinguish protein-abundance remodeling from phosphorylation changes not explained by comparable parent-protein abundance changes. Label-free nano-LC-MS/MS data were processed using quality control, filtering, missing-value imputation, normalization, and paired statistical testing. Whole-proteome analysis retained 3653 proteins and identified 314 significantly altered proteins, including 79 increased and 235 decreased proteins in HCC. Phosphoproteome analysis retained 1682 phosphopeptides and identified 189 significantly altered phosphopeptides, including 81 increased and 108 decreased events. Integrated analysis showed that 132 significant phosphopeptides matched quantified parent proteins; 112 were classified as phospho-only events, and 20 showed concordant phosphopeptide and parent-protein changes. Reactome enrichment of phospho-only parent proteins highlighted immune/inflammatory processes, metabolic remodeling, ER-stress/protein-folding responses, apoptosis, RHO/RHOBTB GTPase-related regulation, and post-translational phosphorylation. Candidate prioritization identified phosphorylation events for future validation. Overall, this paired multi-layer proteomic analysis demonstrates that HCC tissue exhibits both protein-abundance remodeling and phosphorylation-level rewiring, supporting integrated proteome–phosphoproteome profiling as a strategy to resolve regulatory alterations in cancer tissue.
items.authors: Shafaq Saleem, Muhammad Salman Sajid, Rency S. Varghese, Lin Liu, Vinona Muralidaran, Alexander Kroemer
items.title_zh: 整合蛋白质组与磷酸化组分析揭示肝细胞癌中的磷酸化重塑
items.summary_zh: 肝细胞癌（HCC）具有广泛的分子异质性，单纯的蛋白质丰度变化无法完全反映驱动肿瘤生物学的调控变化。本研究对配对的HCC及相邻非肿瘤肝组织进行了整合的全蛋白质组和磷酸化组分析，以区分蛋白质丰度重塑与未能通过母蛋白丰度变化解释的磷酸化变化。采用无标记纳米液相色谱-质谱联用技术处理数据，经过质量控制、过滤、缺失值插补、标准化和配对统计检验。全蛋白质组分析保留了3653种蛋白质，识别出314种显著变化的蛋白质，其中79种在HCC中增加，235种减少。磷酸化组分析保留了1682种磷肽，识别出189种显著变化的磷肽，其中81种增加，108种减少。整合分析显示132种显著磷肽与定量母蛋白匹配，112种被分类为仅磷酸化事件，20种显示磷肽与母蛋白的变化一致。

items.title: Factors Associated with Adjuvant Radiotherapy Use After Simpson Grade I Resection of WHO Grade 2 Meningioma: A Single-Center Retrospective Cohort Study
items.abstract: Background: Adjuvant radiotherapy (RT) after gross-total resection of World Health Organization (WHO) grade 2 meningioma remains an individualized decision in the absence of definitive randomized evidence. We aimed to identify the clinical, radiological, and pathological factors associated with observed adjuvant RT allocation after Simpson grade I resection and to evaluate the discriminatory performance of proliferative biomarkers in real-world multidisciplinary practice. Methods: This single-center, retrospective cohort included 65 patients, of whom 56 undergoing Simpson grade I resection constituted the primary analytic cohort. Associations with observed RT allocation were evaluated using Firth-penalized logistic regression. Ki-67 and mitotic-index discrimination was summarized using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis, and Ki-67 threshold stability was assessed in 5000 bootstrap resamples. Brain invasion was evaluated in a documented-case sensitivity analysis. Results: Adjuvant RT was administered to 24 of 56 patients (42.9%). In models adjusted for age, sex, neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio, and tumor size, each 5-percentage-point increase in Ki-67 was associated with higher odds of RT allocation (OR 7.10, 95% CI 2.20–22.94; p = 0.001), as was each increase of 5 mitoses per 10 high-power fields in mitotic index (OR 5.81, 95% CI 2.01–16.75; p = 0.001). Ki-67 showed greater apparent discrimination than mitotic index (area under the curve [AUC] 0.925 vs. 0.801; DeLong p = 0.008). The apparent Youden-optimal Ki-67 threshold was 14%, but thresholds of 12%, 14%, and 15% were selected in 33.4%, 41.9%, and 23.1% of bootstrap samples. Among 44 patients with documented brain-invasion status, Ki-67 remained associated with RT allocation after adjustment for brain invasion (OR 4.53, 95% CI 1.77–11.63; p = 0.002). Conclusions: Ki-67 and mitotic index were associated with observed RT allocation, but both markers were already available to the tumor board. These findings describe institutional treatment-allocation patterns and do not establish RT benefit or validate a Ki-67 threshold for recommending treatment.
items.authors: Yasar Unsal, Mehmet Ozgur Ozates, Recai Kulak, Erva Eser, Atilla Kazanci
items.title_zh: 与WHO II级脑膜瘤术后辅助放疗相关的因素研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：在缺乏明确随机证据的情况下，WHO II级脑膜瘤全切除术后辅助放疗的决策仍然个体化。本研究旨在识别与Simpson I级切除术后辅助放疗分配相关的临床、影像学和病理因素，并评估增殖生物标志物在多学科实践中的区分能力。方法：本单中心回顾性队列研究纳入65名患者，其中56名接受Simpson I级切除术的患者构成主要分析队列。使用Firth惩罚逻辑回归评估与辅助放疗分配的关联。通过受试者工作特征（ROC）分析总结Ki-67和有丝分裂指数的区分能力，并在5000个自助重抽样中评估Ki-67阈值的稳定性。结果：56名患者中有24名（42.9%）接受了辅助放疗。在调整年龄、性别、中性粒细胞与淋巴细胞比率及肿瘤大小后，Ki-67每增加5个百分点与辅助放疗分配的几率显著相关（OR 7.10, 95% CI 2.20–22.94; p = 0.001），而有丝分裂指数每增加5个有丝分裂相对于10个高倍视野也显示出相似的关联（OR 5.81, 95% CI 2.01–16.75; p = 0.001）。

items.title: Development and Initial Calibration of a Five-Dimensional Sustainability-Focused Digital Marketing Scale for Thai SMEs
items.abstract: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) increasingly combine digital customer engagement with sustainability practices, yet the literature reviewed for this study offered limited evidence of an integrated measure. This study initially calibrates a sustainability-focused extension of the 4E marketing mix, adding Environmental Responsibility as a bounded practice dimension to Experience, Exchange, Everyplace, and Evangelism. Three rounds with 23 experts refined 65 indicators; an adapted multi-stakeholder rough-set screen retained 62. Same-sample, model-generating calibration produced a 28-item specification, which was held fixed and reassessed after exact-copy screening using 541 nonduplicate Thai SME responses. Conventional reliability estimates met the stated criteria. Average variance extracted exceeded 0.50 for all dimensions in the primary model, but fell below this criterion for Experience in several sensitivity specifications. The principal correlated five-factor model fit better than the theory-specified second-order model (comparative fit index = 0.944 versus 0.939; root mean square error of approximation = 0.057 versus 0.059). Robust maximum-likelihood results were broadly supportive, whereas ordinal weighted least squares evidence was mixed. Discriminant validity remained provisional for Experience–Exchange and Exchange–Everyplace. The study integrates established rough-set principles into multi-stakeholder screening and offers an initial five-dimensional operationalization. A general 5E score is not established; independent-sample confirmation is required before scoring or benchmarking.
items.authors: Patrick Leelayana, Somchai Lekcharoen, Sumaman Pankham

items.title: Modeling Nutrient Concentrations in a Greenhouse Cascade Soilless System
items.abstract: A dynamic simulation model was developed and calibrated to predict nutrient concentrations in a three-level cascade hydroponic system (CasH). The performance of the model was evaluated across donor/primary (tomato) and receiver secondary (mint, peppermint), and tertiary (sea fennel, lemon balm) crops. An independent dataset was available for both calibration and evaluation of the primary tomato crop, whereas data for the secondary and tertiary stages were used exclusively for model calibration. Following model evaluation, three distinct operational scenarios were simulated, ranging from a baseline monoculture to a comprehensive three-stage cascade system. The simulations forecasted the progressive nutrient accumulation across stages, identifying the operational point at which critical sodium and salinity thresholds are approached. The proposed model shows potential as a foundational component for digital twins of hydroponic systems, complementing rather than replacing physical sensors by providing dynamic hourly simulations of nutrient dynamics. The model serves as an effective tool for optimizing resource efficiency and mitigating salinity risks in sustainable, closed-loop horticultural systems. These findings confirm the feasibility of nutrient-specific tracking in closed-loop horticulture, though independent evaluation was restricted to the primary stage, and the empirical coefficients remain specific to the evaluated three-stage CasH configuration.
items.authors: Eleni Karatsivou, Angeliki Elvanidi, Nikolaos Katsoulas

items.title: Recent Advances in Functional Polyisoprene: From Precision Synthesis to Smart Elastomers
items.abstract: Polyisoprene is an important elastomer with a tunable microstructure and a hydrocarbon backbone analogous to the rubber component of natural rubber. However, conventional synthetic polyisoprene lacks the complex intermolecular interactions associated with non-rubber components in natural rubber, limiting its mechanical performance and functional versatility. Recent advances in precision polymerization and functionalization provide new opportunities for developing high-performance and adaptive polyisoprene elastomers. This review summarizes progress in polyisoprene precision synthesis, microstructure control, and functionalization, with emphasis on the relationships among molecular structure, chemical reactivity, network architecture, and macroscopic properties. Coordination and living/controlled polymerization enable regulation of stereoregularity, molecular weight, and chain-end functionality, while epoxidation, hydroxyl functionalization, halogenation, click chemistry, and grafting provide versatile routes to functional polyisoprene. Dynamic covalent bonds and supramolecular interactions further enable reinforced, self-healing, reprocessable, recyclable, and stimuli-responsive elastomers. Importantly, their overall performance depends on balancing chain mobility, intermolecular interactions, network stability, and bond-exchange dynamics. Finally, emerging applications and challenges in multifunctionality and sustainability are discussed, providing molecular-design principles for next-generation functional polyisoprene elastomers.
items.authors: Ji Ma, Guangye Liu, Dandan Liu, Naixiu Ding, Lixia He
items.title_zh: 功能性聚异戊二烯的最新进展：从精确合成到智能弹性体
items.summary_zh: 聚异戊二烯是一种重要的弹性体，具有可调的微观结构和类似天然橡胶的碳氢骨架。然而，传统合成的聚异戊二烯缺乏与天然橡胶中非橡胶成分相关的复杂分子间相互作用，限制了其机械性能和功能多样性。近期在精确聚合和功能化方面的进展为开发高性能和自适应的聚异戊二烯弹性体提供了新机遇。本文总结了聚异戊二烯的精确合成、微观结构控制和功能化的进展，强调了分子结构、化学反应性、网络结构和宏观性质之间的关系。协调聚合和活性/受控聚合使得立体规整性、分子量和链端功能的调控成为可能，而环氧化、羟基功能化、卤素化、点击化学和接枝等方法则为功能性聚异戊二烯提供了多样化的途径。动态共价键和超分子相互作用进一步赋予了增强、自愈、可再加工、可回收和刺激响应的弹性体。其整体性能依赖于链的流动性、分子间相互作用、网络稳定性和键交换动力学的平衡。

items.title: WeatherAgent-SAM: Text-Grounded Agentic Tool Selection for Robust SAM Segmentation
items.abstract: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) provides a versatile promptable segmentation interface, but adverse weather and image degradation can obscure visual cues and substantially reduce its accuracy. Existing approaches mainly follow two directions to mitigate this issue. The first adapts SAM through fine-tuning or additional trainable modules, which requires model-side optimization. The second preprocesses degraded images before SAM inference, but such methods are generally optimized for perceptual restoration rather than downstream segmentation. We introduce WeatherAgent-SAM, an agentic framework that improves degraded-image segmentation through response-conditioned preprocessing selection while keeping SAM frozen. WeatherAgent-SAM takes SAM’s initial response and a spatial prompt as inputs and uses response-conditioned knowledge to determine which preprocessing method should be applied next. To realize this process, the framework comprises two key modules. First, Fine-Grained Response-Conditioned Knowledge Construction adopts a progressive coarse-to-fine strategy: it first categorizes SAM responses into recurring states and then explores how individual preprocessing methods affect segmentation within each state. This design enables the agent to distinguish methods that pursue similar enhancement objectives but produce different segmentation outcomes. Second, a learnable Mask Verifier estimates the quality of each resulting SAM mask without ground truth and provides feedback to the agent, allowing tool selection to proceed iteratively and stop when a satisfactory prediction is identified. Experiments demonstrate that WeatherAgent-SAM achieves results comparable to those of the evaluated baselines on the Robust-Seg dataset and outperforms SAM, RobustSAM, and GaRA-SAM-Syn on the ACDC dataset.
items.authors: Yifei Zhang, Honglin Sun, Junyang Zhang, Shu Zhao, Kenji Hashimoto

items.title: Attention-Guided Digital Enhancement of Museum Artifact Photographs Using Progressive Curriculum Learning
items.abstract: Physical deterioration and image-quality loss can reduce the legibility of museum photographs and limit their value for digital access, cataloging, and visual analysis. This study evaluates an Attention ResUNet for grayscale enhancement under heterogeneous degradation and revisits the contribution of progressive training using compute-matched controls. A curated set of 5816 Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access objects was divided at the object level into 4071 training, 872 validation, and 873 test objects. In the original five-epoch Phase-II ablation, staged initialization outperformed direct five-epoch training, but this advantage did not persist after total optimization exposure was matched. Direct 15-epoch ResUNet reached 29.777 dB PSNR and direct 15-epoch Attention ResUNet reached 29.862 dB, compared to 29.340 and 29.419 dB for their staged counterparts under the same 43,125-step budget. An independent set of 45 photographs captured on site at the Peshawar Museum was reserved for post-selection evaluation. Direct enhancement of the untouched photographs was assessed with no-reference indicators, with NIQE decreasing from 4.996 to 4.237 and BRISQUE from 23.171 to 18.479. A separate reference-based experiment retained each original photograph as an image-domain target, added deterministic Gaussian noise (σ=10), and restored the degraded input with the compute-matched Attention ResUNet (C15). Across all 45 photographs, mean PSNR increased from 28.149±0.045 to 29.740±0.914 dB, SSIM from 0.8136±0.0555 to 0.8985±0.0183, and LPIPS decreased from 0.1140±0.0459 to 0.0668±0.0242. SSIM and MAE improved in all 45 cases, while PSNR improved in 40/45 and LPIPS in 44/45 cases. A structured blinded assessment on 15 paired cases found the C15 output closer to the pre-corruption reference in 14/15 comparisons; a second independent reviewer provided qualitative corroboration but did not complete a second image-level score sheet. The paired experiment establishes recovery from a known image-domain corruption, not reconstruction of the artifact’s historically pristine physical state. The method remains limited to grayscale structural and luminance enhancement, and processed outputs should remain linked to the original photographs.
items.authors: Asim Saleem, Kun Li, Ping Chen

items.title: Sustainable Raw Earth–Straw Fiber Composites: Estimated Sound Insulation Potential and Building-Relevant Properties
items.abstract: This study presents a comprehensive multiphysics characterization of unstabilized raw earth and earth–wheat straw composites to address the scarcity of data regarding their acoustic performance. Four soils from the Champagne-Ardenne region were initially analyzed to evaluate the impact of mineralogical composition, specifically calcium carbonate (CaCO3), on sound absorption. Results indicate that despite compositional variability, sound absorption remains low (αw = 0.12–0.19), while no clear influence of mineralogical variability was identified within the investigated soil set. While raw earth demonstrates limited experimentally measured sound absorption, its high surface mass suggests a potentially favorable sound-insulation performance, as indicated by theoretical mass-law estimates. Subsequently, wheat straw (0–6 wt%) was incorporated into a selected soil to develop lightweight composites. Increasing fiber content reduced bulk density by up to 35% and markedly enhanced sound absorption (αw up to 0.34, a 162% increase) due to increased porosity and fiber–matrix interactions. Furthermore, thermal conductivity decreased, improving insulation. Although these improvements coincided with a transition from brittle to ductile mechanical behavior and reduced stiffness—limiting their use to infill or self-supporting structures—the composites maintained good-to-excellent moisture buffering and satisfactory short-term resistance under the investigated water-exposure conditions. These findings support the potential of earth–straw composites for low-impact, non-structural building applications.
items.authors: Fabien Beaumont, Sébastien Murer, Sameh Balti, Céline Rousse, Erwan Hamard, Guillaume Polidori

items.title: Modeling the Relationship Between Ride-Hailing Demand Density and the Urban Built Environment on the Basis of the GNNWR and Dynamic Spatial Partitioning
items.abstract: Understanding the complex spatiotemporal heterogeneity between ride-hailing demand and the urban built environment is crucial for optimizing urban space and allocating transportation resources. Previous analyses using fixed spatial scales (e.g., regular grids or administrative boundaries) often suffer from the modifiable areal unit problem (MAUP) and fail to capture the actual distribution of ride-hailing demand. Furthermore, traditional geographically weighted regression (GWR) models struggle with nonlinear spatial relationships. To address these challenges, this study uses Xiamen, China, as a case study. We employ the K-means++ clustering method on ride-hailing origin–destination (OD) data to generate dynamic spatial partitioning units, integrating them with points of interest (POIs), land use, and population data. A geographically neural network weighted regression (GNNWR) model is then introduced to quantify how built environment factors influence mobility, explicitly capturing nonlinear variations. Results show that dynamic spatial partitioning effectively mitigates the MAUP: the traditional GWR R2 improved from 0.414 (administrative units) and 0.577 (regular grids) to 0.649. Using these dynamic clustering units, the GNNWR model achieved an average R2 of 0.750, outperforming multiscale GWR (MGWR, 0.614) and traditional GWR (0.596) by approximately 22.1% and 25.8%, respectively. Empirically, the built environment’s impact exhibits pronounced spatiotemporal nonstationarity. Residential and office areas reveal distinct tidal commuting patterns driven by job-housing separation, while public transit density shows a dual substitution–complementarity relationship with ride-hailing. Ultimately, this research validates GNNWR’s applicability for microlevel geographic analysis, providing a robust scientific basis for differentiated traffic management and precise urban spatial planning.
items.authors: Zhiwei Zhu, Yuxuan Li, Xinxin Zhang

items.title: Dynamic Parameter Selection for CKKS Fully Homomorphic Encryption and Its RNS Variant
items.abstract: In recent years, the Cheon–Kim–Kim–Song (CKKS) scheme has gained widespread popularity among practitioners due to its support for approximate arithmetic on encrypted data. However, the decrypted outputs of CKKS inherently contain approximation errors arising from homomorphic operations. If the error term in the ciphertext grows too large, the decrypted results may no longer satisfy the required precision or correctness. To mitigate this issue, error analysis and parameter selection must be performed in advance. Nevertheless, deriving tight error bounds and selecting efficient parameters while jointly satisfying security, correctness, precision, and efficiency requirements remain challenging. To address this, we propose a distribution-aware error analysis method for CKKS and the residue number system (RNS) CKKS to derive tighter probabilistic bounds under the stated assumptions. The method propagates coefficient means and variances through the computation before estimating the final error bound, rather than propagating intermediate norm bounds. Based on this analysis, we further develop a dynamic parameter selector for CKKS. This evaluator can generate an efficient valid parameter set by comprehensively considering security, correctness, circuit depth, and decryption precision for given computational tasks. Moreover, by employing the dynamic parameter evaluation method, the evaluator produces parameter sets that are more closely tailored to the specified computational requirements. Here, dynamic selection refers to feedback-based parameter adjustment before homomorphic evaluation.
items.authors: Yu Zhan, Zhen Zhao, Yanbo Wang, Baocang Wang

items.title: Multimodal Trust Assessment in Human–AI Shared Control Systems
items.abstract: Trust plays an important role in human–AI shared-control systems, yet it is difficult to assess from a single observable signal. This study proposes an event-centered multimodal framework for assessing situational trust by integrating contextual, behavioral, affective, and individual features surrounding critical human–AI interaction events. A controlled autonomous-driving experiment was conducted with 15 participants under high- and low-reliability conditions, yielding 117 valid event-level observations with retrospective trust ratings. The results showed substantial differences in reported trust between reliability conditions and across failure types, while facial and failure-related contextual indicators were among the more informative variables. However, the highly imbalanced trust classes, particularly the limited number of high-trust observations, constrained reliable classification of individual trust levels. The findings only provide preliminary evidence that event-level multimodal observations can characterize information associated with reported situational trust, while also demonstrating the challenges of cross-user trust estimation under limited and imbalanced data. Therefore, the study serves as a methodological and empirical starting point for developing more robust multimodal trust assessment approaches, rather than as a validation of a generalized real-time trust prediction system.
items.authors: Mengchu Song, Hongyu Zhou, Guohua Wu
items.title_zh: 人机共享控制系统中的多模态信任评估
items.summary_zh: 信任在人人工智能共享控制系统中扮演重要角色，但难以通过单一可观察信号进行评估。本研究提出了一种以事件为中心的多模态框架，通过整合关键人机交互事件周围的情境、行为、情感和个体特征来评估情境信任。研究在高可靠性和低可靠性条件下进行了控制的自动驾驶实验，共有15名参与者，获得117个有效事件级观察及回顾性信任评分。结果显示，不同可靠性条件和故障类型之间的报告信任存在显著差异，而面部和故障相关的情境指标是较为信息丰富的变量。然而，高度不平衡的信任类别，尤其是高信任观察数量有限，限制了个体信任水平的可靠分类。研究结果仅提供了事件级多模态观察能够表征与报告的情境信任相关信息的初步证据，同时展示了在有限和不平衡数据下跨用户信任估计的挑战。因此，本研究为开发更稳健的多模态信任评估方法提供了方法论和实证起点。

items.title: Lightweight Cross-Condition Tool Wear Prediction via Transfer Learning for Resource-Constrained Edge Manufacturing
items.abstract: In resource-constrained manufacturing environments, accurate prediction of tool wear under variable cutting conditions remains challenging due to the trade-off between computational overhead and prognostic reliability. Conventional signal processing and deep learning methods suffer from high model complexity, cross-domain distribution discrepancies, and excessive computation cost, limiting their practical deployment on edge devices. This paper proposes an optimized cloud–edge collaborative transfer learning framework for lightweight remaining useful life (RUL) prediction of milling tools. On the cloud side, a low-complexity stacked auto-encoder built on a 1D-SqueezeNet is trained with cross-domain adaptation constraints to improve generalization across working conditions. Pretrained model parameters are then transferred to edge hardware for deep feature extraction. A kernel extreme learning machine (KELM) is further adopted for fast on-site tool wear regression prediction. When validated on full-lifecycle milling vibration data collected under real machining conditions, the proposed approach achieves nearly identical prediction performance on edge devices compared with cloud-side inference while also reducing edge inference latency to 0.01–0.021 s. These results demonstrate that the presented framework can deliver accurate prediction of milling tool RUL and provide rapid response under limited edge computational resources.
items.authors: Jianliang He, Yinhao Zhang, Caihong Han, Chen Yin
items.category_raw: Journal of Manufacturing and Materials Processing

items.title: From Brittleness to Superplasticity: Tailoring the Properties of Fe–Cr–Co Alloys
items.abstract: Fe–Cr–Co alloys are deformable hard-magnetic materials that combine high coercivity with the possibility of conventional thermomechanical processing. In this work, the transition from limited ductility to superplastic deformation was investigated in industrial 23Kh15KT (Fe–23Cr–15Co) and 30Kh23K (Fe–30Cr–23Co) alloys by varying phase composition and phase morphology. Tensile tests were conducted at 800–1050 °C and strain rates of 1.6 × 10−4–1.6 × 10−1 s−1. The microstructures were characterized using optical microscopy, scanning electron microscopy, transmission electron microscopy, and X-ray diffraction to evaluate phase constitution, grain size, and the evolution from lamellar to globular microduplex morphologies. The ultrafine-grained globular structures exhibited features characteristic of superplastic deformation during high-temperature tensile testing. The most favorable tensile response was observed at 900 °C for 23Kh15KT and at 950 °C for 30Kh23K. Under these conditions, the globular microduplex states showed high elongation to failure and strain-rate sensitivity coefficients of approximately m = 0.43 and m = 0.47, respectively. In contrast, the initially lamellar 23Kh15KT structure showed pronounced strain hardening and only partial fragmentation and spheroidization of the lamellae. In 30Kh23K, the lamellar morphology transformed more completely into a fine globular microduplex structure, which was accompanied by stable high-temperature deformation behavior. The results demonstrate that grain refinement alone is insufficient to promote superplasticity in Fe–Cr–Co alloys; the formation of a fine globular microduplex morphology is also required to provide favorable conditions for grain-boundary-sliding-mediated deformation. Complementary compression experiments revealed progressive fragmentation and spheroidization of lamellar structures at elevated temperatures. These findings provide a structural basis for the thermomechanical processing and potential superplastic forming of complex-shaped Fe–Cr–Co alloy components.
items.authors: Galiia F. Korznikova

items.title: Infinite Series About Reciprocal Products of Fibonacci and Lucas Numbers
items.abstract: Infinite series about reciprocal products of Fibonacci and Lucas numbers are systematically examined. This is done by incorporating the telescoping method, Cassini-like identities and partial fractions, as well as the induction principle. Numerous closed formulae are presented with most of them not having appeared previously.
items.authors: Marta Na Chen, Wenchang Chu

items.title: From Measured Accuracy to Patient Outcome: Navigation in Total Hip Arthroplasty and Molecular Diagnosis of Periprosthetic Joint Infection: A Narrative Review
items.abstract: Background: Total hip arthroplasty (THA) and the diagnosis of periprosthetic joint infection (PJI) have each acquired a technology that measures with high precision: intraoperative navigation, which reports component position to within a few degrees, and molecular methods, which identify the infecting organism and the host response at genomic resolution. Objective: To establish whether the measured accuracy has been shown to reach the patient as a clinical outcome. Methods: This is a narrative review, reported according to SANRA. MEDLINE, Scopus, and Web of Science databases were searched from inception to 31 August 2026. English-language studies in humans were eligible if they reported positional or diagnostic accuracy, a patient-level clinical or economic outcome after THA or after treatment of PJI or osteomyelitis, or a factor modifying the relation between the two. Animal, in vitro, and cadaveric studies, conference abstracts, and reports without extractable data were excluded. Forty studies were included. No pooled estimate was calculated, and no new statistical analysis was performed. Results: Navigation reduced positional outliers consistently, but in two matched claims-based cohorts of patients with morbid obesity (4499 and 5835 patients), it was not associated with lower rates of PJI, dislocation, periprosthetic fracture, mechanical loosening, or revision within two years. Candidate immunogenetic variants in osteomyelitis have never been tested against a treatment decision. Metagenomic sequencing was no more accurate than culture (sensitivity 63.2% versus 68.4%; specificity 80.0% versus 95.0%) except after antibiotic exposure. Reported infection rates and test accuracy both change with the case definition applied. Conclusions: In both settings, the limiting factor is the design of the studies linking measurement to outcome rather than the precision of the measurement.
items.authors: Vladislav Andonov, Vensan Velchov, Yasen Nikolov, Nikolay Cherkezov, Dimitar Tenev, Michail Dimitrov
items.title_zh: 全髋关节置换术导航与假体周围关节感染分子诊断的综述
items.summary_zh: 背景：全髋关节置换术（THA）和假体周围关节感染（PJI）的诊断均采用高精度技术：术中导航和分子方法。目的：探讨测量的准确性是否能转化为临床结果。方法：本研究为叙述性综述，依据SANRA标准进行。检索MEDLINE、Scopus和Web of Science数据库，时间范围为创立至2026年8月31日。符合条件的英文研究需报告位置或诊断准确性、THA后或PJI/骨髓炎治疗后的临床或经济结果，或影响二者关系的因素。排除动物、体外及尸体研究、会议摘要及无可提取数据的报告。共纳入40项研究。结果：导航技术一致性地减少了位置异常，但在两组重度肥胖患者（4499和5835人）中，未发现其与PJI、脱位、假体周围骨折、机械松动或两年内修复率降低相关。

items.title: Microplastics and the Kidney: A Narrative Review of Human Evidence, Molecular Mechanisms of Cell Injury, and Future Directions
items.abstract: Microplastics (MPs) are widespread environmental contaminants, but their potential effects on kidney health remain poorly defined. As an organ continuously exposed to circulating particles and involved in their urinary elimination, the kidney may represent both a target of MP toxicity and a route of excretion. In this narrative review, we examine current evidence linking MPs to kidney injury, integrating experimental, mechanistic, and human data. Particular attention is given to the early events governing particle–cell interactions. After exposure, micro- and nanoplastics acquire an eco- and biomolecular corona that modifies their surface properties, cellular recognition, uptake, and biodistribution. Following internalization through phagocytic and endocytic pathways, particles may accumulate within endolysosomal compartments and interact with intracellular structures, disrupting cellular homeostasis. In renal cells, these events converge on mitochondrial dysfunction, reactive oxygen species generation, endoplasmic reticulum stress, inflammatory signaling, altered autophagy, and regulated cell death. Several interconnected pathways have been implicated, including Keap1–Nrf2/ARE and NF-κB signaling, MAPK and IRE1/XBP1-mediated stress responses, ACSL4–GPX4-related ferroptosis, and TGF-β1-related profibrotic signaling. Human studies have detected MPs in urine and kidney tissue and provide preliminary evidence linking MP burden with early markers of kidney damage, although current findings remain limited by small study populations and substantial methodological heterogeneity. Patients with chronic kidney disease, particularly those receiving dialysis, may represent a population of special interest because potentially altered renal handling may coexist with repeated exposure to polymer-based medical devices and dialysis fluids. Despite this potential relevance, data on MP exposure and accumulation in CKD and dialysis patients remain remarkably scarce. We finally discuss the limitations of current experimental models and analytical methods and the need for standardized biomonitoring, more environmentally relevant particles and exposure concentrations, and detection strategies capable of reaching the nanoscale, including artificial intelligence-assisted analysis. Overall, available evidence provides a mechanistic basis for MP-induced kidney injury, but its clinical relevance and contribution to human kidney disease remain to be established.
items.authors: Edoardo La Porta, Micaela Gentile, Marco Quaglia, Serena Ducoli, Sara Massardo, Daniela Verzola
items.title_zh: 微塑料与肾脏：人类证据及细胞损伤机制的叙述性综述
items.summary_zh: 微塑料（MPs）是广泛存在的环境污染物，但其对肾脏健康的潜在影响尚不明确。肾脏作为一个持续暴露于循环颗粒并参与其尿液排泄的器官，可能既是微塑料毒性的靶标，又是排泄途径。本文综述了当前将微塑料与肾脏损伤联系起来的证据，整合了实验、机制和人类数据。特别关注颗粒与细胞相互作用的早期事件。暴露后，微塑料会获得生态和生物分子冠层，改变其表面特性、细胞识别、摄取和生物分布。颗粒通过吞噬和内吞途径内化后，可能在内溶酶体内积累并与细胞内结构相互作用，破坏细胞稳态。这些事件在肾细胞中汇聚于线粒体功能障碍、活性氧生成、内质网应激、炎症信号、改变的自噬和调控性细胞死亡等方面。多条相互关联的信号通路被涉及，包括Keap1–Nrf2/ARE、NF-κB、MAPK和IRE1/XBP1介导的应激反应等。人类研究已在尿液和肾组织中检测到微塑料。

items.title: Before Heaven Yet in Accord: Reexamining the xiantian 先天 (Ahead of Heaven) Doctrine in the Yijing and Its Commentarial Tradition
items.abstract: The concept of xiantian 先天 (“ahead of Heaven”) in the Yijing has long been interpreted either as a cosmological claim about the priority of cosmic principles or as an epistemological assertion about the sage’s capacity for foreknowledge, yet neither approach has systematically examined its internal philosophical structure. This study examines whether xiantian possesses a consistent logic connecting the cosmological, practical, and existential dimensions of the Yijing by distinguishing three interrelated dimensions and tracing their progressive development. The first dimension concerns Heaven’s priority to human beings. Within the dynamic structure of the Three Powers (sancai 三才) of Heaven, Earth, and humanity, human beings are always situated within the transformations of Heaven and Earth. Heaven is therefore prior to human beings in the generative, principial, and axiological senses, while this priority at the same time provides the conditions under which human participation in these transformations becomes possible. The second dimension concerns humanity’s acting ahead of Heaven. Through the cultivation practices of “refining the principles and entering into the numinous” (jingyi rushen 精義入神) and “exhausting the numinous and knowing transformation” (qiongshen zhihua 窮神知化), human beings transform this possibility of participation into the actual agency to understand and respond to change. The capacity for “knowing the incipient” (zhiji 知幾) further shows how such cultivated agency can manifest itself as temporal aheadness, enabling the sage to discern and respond to change before it has fully taken form. The third dimension concerns the ultimate transcendence of the distinction between xiantian and houtian 後天 (“after Heaven”) in the sage’s accomplished state. At this level, “acting ahead of Heaven” and “acting after Heaven” no longer constitute two opposing modes of action, since human agency has come fully into accord with the Dao of Heaven. These three dimensions together reveal a continuous movement from Heaven’s priority, through cultivated human agency, to the consummate accord between Heaven and human beings. Understood in this way, xiantian provides an important conceptual axis connecting cosmology, self-cultivation, and the realized relationship between Heaven and human beings in the Yijing.
items.authors: Shijie Tang

items.title: Detector Response and Energy-Threshold Optimization for Imaging with Cosmic-Ray Muon-Induced Secondary Radiation
items.abstract: Imaging with cosmic-ray muon-induced secondary radiation complements muon transmission radiography and muon scattering tomography by exploiting the electrons and bremsstrahlung photons created along the muon track inside the target. Because these secondaries are produced predominantly at low energies, the performance of such a system depends critically on parameters that are usually treated as routine: the uniformity of the response of the surrounding scintillator array and the energy threshold applied during acquisition. This contribution reports the instrumental characterization of the muon camera (MUCA) setup operated at the University of Novi Sad, comprising a five-layer Close Cathode Chamber tracker and four large-area plastic scintillation detectors. Over a continuous run of about 24 h, the combined tracking efficiency was about 0.96 and stable at the percent level. Single-detector and joint spectra recorded with 137Cs and a bulk KCl source were used to equalize the high voltage across the array, and the acquisition threshold was set to approximately 230 keV. A direct comparison of images of a copper cylinder reconstructed with a 250 keV and with a 1 MeV analysis cut shows that the conventional MeV-level threshold discards the majority of the target-related signal. The corresponding limitation of the geometrical acceptance is also discussed. The design of the COMIS upgrade, which extends the scintillator coverage to the forward region and introduces a compact multi-channel readout, is outlined together with a first map of the light collection uniformity of its large-area scintillators.
items.authors: Kristina Bikit, Gergő Hamar, Danijel Velimirović, Gábor Galgóczi, Jan Hansman, Dusan Mrdja

items.title: Radiation Exposure in Acute Endovascular Stroke Treatment: A Focus on Mechanical Thrombectomy
items.abstract: Objectives: Systematically evaluating radiation exposure during mechanical thrombectomy (MT) for acute endovascular stroke treatment at a high-volume centre to generate evidence to evaluate diagnostic reference levels (DRLs) and to support strategies for radiation dose optimization. Methods: Demographic (age, sex, body mass index), procedural (technical approach, number of passes), dosimetric (dose–area product [DAP], fluoroscopy time, number of acquisition series), and anatomical parameters were retrospectively analyzed in a cohort of 390 patients undergoing mechanical thrombectomy on a biplane flat-panel detector system using a standardized workflow and a dedicated low-dose protocol. Nonparametric statistical methods as well as univariate and multivariate regression were used, and p-values 0.05 were considered statistically significant. Results: Median total DAP was 4741.33 cGy·cm2, with fluoroscopy contributing approximately 51% of the total dose. In the multivariable regression analysis, the number of thrombectomy passes, fluoroscopy time, and number of imaging series were independent predictors of increased radiation exposure. In univariable analyses, radiation exposure was significantly associated with procedural duration, recanalization time, and BMI (all p 0.001). Greater procedural complexity, including combined thrombectomy techniques (p = 0.02) and adjunctive stenting (p 0.001), was associated with higher DAP but was not independently predictive in the multivariable model. In contrast, anatomical and demographic factors had a limited impact: stroke location (anterior versus posterior circulation), laterality, and age were not significantly associated with radiation exposure, whereas distal occlusions (p 0.001) and female gender (p 0.001) were associated with lower DAP. Conclusions: Mechanical thrombectomy for acute endovascular stroke treatment can be performed with low radiation exposure using standardized workflows, optimized low-dose protocols, dose-reduction technologies, and, where feasible, monoplane imaging. Procedural rather than anatomical or demographic factors drive radiation exposure.
items.authors: Sabine Sari, Marlitt Anna Dorzok-Bieker, Eva-Maria Hammerschmidt, Tobias Struffert
items.title_zh: 急性血管内中风治疗中的辐射暴露：机械取栓的研究
items.summary_zh: 目的：系统评估在高流量中心进行机械取栓（MT）治疗急性血管内中风时的辐射暴露，以生成评估诊断参考水平（DRLs）的证据，并支持辐射剂量优化策略。方法：对390名接受机械取栓的患者进行回顾性分析，评估人口统计学（年龄、性别、体重指数）、操作（技术方法、取栓次数）、剂量学（剂量-面积积[DAP]、透视时间、成像系列数量）和解剖参数。采用非参数统计方法及单变量和多变量回归分析，p值<0.05被视为统计显著。结果：中位总DAP为4741.33 cGy·cm²，透视约占总剂量的51%。多变量回归分析显示，取栓次数、透视时间和成像系列数量是辐射暴露增加的独立预测因子。单变量分析中，辐射暴露与操作持续时间、再通时间和BMI显著相关（均p<0.001）。操作复杂性增加，包括联合取栓技术（p=0.02）和辅助支架使用。

items.title: Isolation, Identification and Genomic Characterization of Carbamazepine-Tolerant Bacteria from Contaminated Aquatic Environments
items.abstract: Pharmaceutical contamination in aquatic environments has increased interest in microorganisms able to tolerating these compounds and the mechanisms underlying their tolerance. This study isolated and characterized carbamazepine (CBZ)-tolerant bacteria from contaminated waters of the Machángara River, Quito, Ecuador, and investigated the genome of the most tolerant isolate. Isolates were characterized by morphological and biochemical analyses, and 16S rRNA gene sequencing. Tolerance to CBZ (1–50 mg L−1) was evaluated by culture-based growth measurements. CBZ1, CBZ3, CBZ6, and CBZ7 were taxonomically assigned to Enterobacter hormaechei, Paenibacillus lactis, Aeromonas hydrophila and Raoultella ornithinolytica, respectively. Among the four isolates evaluated, CBZ7 exhibited significantly higher relative growth at elevated CBZ concentrations (30–50 mg L−1) and was therefore selected for whole-genome sequencing. The CBZ7 draft genome comprised 5,671,759 bp distributed across 181 contigs, with a G+C content of 55.65%, an N50 of 79,780 bp, 98.2% BUSCO completeness, and CheckM2 estimates 0.87% contamination. Genome annotation revealed genes associated with membrane transport and efflux, oxidative metabolism, glutathione metabolism, environmental sensing, and aromatic compound metabolism. Although no complete CBZ-specific catabolic pathway was identified, the results support strong tolerance of CBZ7 to elevated CBZ concentrations and identity candidate functions potentially involved in xenobiotic adaptation.
items.authors: Gabriela Méndez, Diana Carrera, Lizbeth Olivo Silva, Elena Coyago-Cruz, Melisa Ortiz, Ivonne Vega
items.title_zh: 从受污染水域分离和鉴定耐卡马西平细菌
items.summary_zh: 本研究从厄瓜多尔基多的Machángara河受污染水域中分离并表征了耐卡马西平（CBZ）细菌，并对最耐受的分离株进行了基因组研究。通过形态学和生化分析以及16S rRNA基因测序对分离株进行了鉴定。通过培养基生长测量评估了对CBZ（1–50 mg L−1）的耐受性。分离的CBZ1、CBZ3、CBZ6和CBZ7分别被归类为肠杆菌属、乳酸芽孢杆菌、嗜水气单胞菌和Raoultella ornithinolytica。在四个分离株中，CBZ7在高浓度CBZ（30–50 mg L−1）下表现出显著更高的相对生长，因此被选为全基因组测序对象。CBZ7的草图基因组包含5,671,759 bp，分布在181个contig中，G+C含量为55.65%，N50为79,780 bp，BUSCO完整性为98.2%，CheckM2估计污染率为0.87%。基因组注释揭示了与膜运输、氧化代谢、谷胱甘肽代谢、环境感知和芳香化合物代谢相关的基因。尽管未识别出完整的CBZ特异性降解途径，但结果支持了强耐受性。
